edit.description: `LayoutError` (:106) gains the read pair its three sibling format errors carry — an I/O variant and a not-UTF-8 variant, each with its own `#[diagnostic(code(temper::layout::…))]` — plus the `impl From<crate::hash::ReadUtf8Error>` those three already spell (`frontmatter.rs:127`, `toml_document.rs:158`, `json_manifest.rs:306`).

`layout_unit` (:562) reads through `crate::hash::read_utf8` mapped to `LayoutError`, retiring the ad-hoc `miette::miette!("failed to read layout document …")` — the only adapter source load in the crate that bypasses the primitive `hash.rs`'s own module header calls "the shared read+UTF-8-decode primitive all formats use to load source files", and the only one whose read failure carries no diagnostic code.

The layout reading wrapper (`read_layout_document`, :2032 today) reads through the same primitive; `DriftError` (:96) gains a not-UTF-8 variant so a non-UTF-8 layout document names itself rather than arriving as an `InvalidData` io string under `DriftError::Read`. The module's projection-target reads (:2141, :2414, :2475, :2751) are a different job — byte comparison against an emitted file, not an adapter source load — and stay as they are.

A layout document whose bytes are not UTF-8 refuses in the layout vocabulary, beside the existing refusal pins (`MissingKey` :140, `Unadmitted` :327, `SwallowedHeading` :555) — today the same input produces an uncoded miette string.

summary: The layout class's document read bypasses the shared read+decode primitive every other format uses, so its read failure has no vocabulary and no diagnostic code.

tests.asserts: a non-UTF-8 layout document refuses with the layout error vocabulary and its diagnostic code, not an ad-hoc miette string

acceptance: Every adapter source load in the crate goes through `hash::read_utf8`, a non-UTF-8 layout document refuses with a coded `LayoutError`, and `cargo test` stays green.
notes: Census by behavior: frontmatter (`frontmatter.rs:177`), json-document (`json_manifest.rs:318`) and toml-document (`toml_document.rs:33`) all funnel through `hash::read_utf8` and map the error into their own vocabulary; the layout class's two reads (`compose.rs:562`, `drift.rs:2032`) do neither. Blocked on the read hoist, which moves both sites. scoped at 6c6146e0
